notes: Not GST-registered at first: the whole menu price is revenue, and the GST paid on ingredients, rent, running costs and commissions is a cost. A level whose yearly sales pass the compulsory-registration threshold is treated as registered (marked).
Tax: Singapore corporate income tax with partial exemption only. The start-up exemption doesn't apply: a company wholly owned by a foreign company doesn't qualify.

Investment is the opening cost less the running reserve: the ramp-up months the reserve pays for are already in the monthly cash. Payback is the first month the cash after tax has paid the investment back.
Estimates: the ramp-up curve and the share of cups sold through delivery apps are build-team assumptions. 'If things go badly' uses the P90 opening cost and a slower ramp-up.
